title: Storm-0940 Steals Corporate Emails via Microsoft Graph OAuth Apps
summary:
Microsoft has discovered that the China-aligned Storm-0940 threat group used OAuth applications to exfiltrate emails and other corporate data through the Microsoft Graph API. This confirmation of data theft follows previous reports that the group had conducted unauthorized authentication activity across multiple customer environments without confirmed evidence of access to specific files.

The group has used the ArtEx AI framework since September 2026 to automate strikes on hundreds of organizations worldwide, including targets in the military, aerospace, energy, and financial services sectors. In several instances, the attackers gained privileged cloud access in less than 3 hours.
